rules.source_quote: Only timekeepers approved in writing by the claims professional may bill time to a file.
rules.notes: Proposed by pattern match. Check the parameters against the sentence before confirming.

rules.source_quote: No more than 3 timekeepers may bill to a file in any invoice period without prior approval.
rules.notes: Proposed by pattern match. Check the parameters against the sentence before confirming.

rules.source_quote: The Company will pay for only 1 attorney to attend a deposition, hearing or mediation unless the claims professional approves a second attendee in advance.
rules.notes: Proposed by pattern match. Check the parameters against the sentence before confirming.

rules.source_quote: No more than 0.3 hour may be billed for any single intra-office conference.
rules.notes: Proposed by pattern match. Check the parameters against the sentence before confirming.

rules.source_quote: Time must be recorded in increments of 0.1 hour.
rules.notes: Proposed by pattern match. Check the parameters against the sentence before confirming.

rules.source_quote: Entries that are routinely rounded up to the half hour or hour will be questioned.
rules.notes: Proposed by pattern match. Check the parameters against the sentence before confirming.

rules.source_quote: Block billing is not permitted and each task must be entered separately with its own time.
rules.notes: Proposed by pattern match. Check the parameters against the sentence before confirming.

rules.source_quote: Vague entries such as "attention to file" or "review documents" will not be paid.
rules.notes: Proposed by pattern match. Check the parameters against the sentence before confirming.

rules.source_quote: Every fee entry must carry a UTBMS task code and activity code, and every expense entry must carry an expense code.

rules.source_quote: The Company will not pay for more than 10 hours billed by one timekeeper in a single day without an explanation.

rules.source_quote: Time entries more than 60 days old on the invoice date will not be paid.
rules.notes: Proposed by pattern match. Check the parameters against the sentence before confirming.

rules.source_quote: Duplicate entries will be rejected.

rules.source_quote: Counsel may not bill at rates above the approved rate schedule for the file.

rules.source_quote: The Company does not pay for clerical work, training, conflicts checks or the preparation of invoices.

rules.source_quote: Legal research exceeding 3 hours on a file requires prior approval from the claims professional.
